mapper.select: SELECT user_id, first_name, middle_name, last_name, birth_date, nationality, gender, residence_country, residence_state, residence_city, residence_address, residence_postal_code, phone_country_code, phone_number, language_preference, timezone, profile_verified, created_at, updated_at FROM t_user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_profile ( user_id, first_name, middle_name, last_name, birth_date, nationality, language_preference, timezone ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{firstName}, #{middleName}, #{lastName}, #{birthDate}, #{nationality}, COALESCE(#{languagePreference}, 'zh-CN'), COALESCE(#{timezone}, 'Asia/Shanghai') )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_profile SET first_name = #{firstName}, middle_name = #{middleName}, last_name = #{lastName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, nationality = #{nationality} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND profile_verified = 0

UPDATE t_user_profile SET gender = #{gender}, residence_country = #{residenceCountry}, residence_state = #{residenceState}, residence_city = #{residenceCity}, residence_address = #{residenceAddress}, residence_postal_code = #{residencePostalCode}, phone_country_code = #{phoneCountryCode}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, language_preference = COALESCE(#{languagePreference}, language_preference), timezone = COALESCE(#{timezone}, timezone) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_user_profile SET profile_verified = #{verified} WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE t_user_profile SET first_name = COALESCE(#{firstName}, first_name), middle_name = COALESCE(#{middleName}, middle_name), last_name = COALESCE(#{lastName}, last_name), birth_date = COALESCE(#{birthDate}, birth_date), nationality = COALESCE(#{nationality}, nationality), gender = COALESCE(#{gender}, gender), residence_country = COALESCE(#{residenceCountry}, residence_country), residence_state = COALESCE(#{residenceState}, residence_state), residence_city = COALESCE(#{residenceCity}, residence_city), residence_address = COALESCE(#{residenceAddress}, residence_address), residence_postal_code = COALESCE(#{residencePostalCode}, residence_postal_code), phone_country_code = COALESCE(#{phoneCountryCode}, phone_country_code), phone_number = COALESCE(#{phoneNumber}, phone_number), language_preference = COALESCE(#{languagePreference}, language_preference), timezone = COALESCE(#{timezone}, timezone) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
